**Fix the typecheck:** `LayoutProps` is generated by Next.js 16, so it doesn't exist until `next typegen` or `next build` has run. Add a script and use it instead of the bare `tsc`:

```json
"typecheck": "next typegen && tsc --noEmit"
```

## `types.ts` vs `backend/app/schemas.py`

Add these to stay in sync:

```ts
export interface Statement { id: string; text: string; author_id: string | null; flag?: ModerationReason | null }
export interface Camp { id: string; name: string; description: string; size: number; member_ids: string[] }
```

`Point.text` is already in both. The backend fills it with what the participant said.

## Real API (PR #7), replaces the mocks in `src/lib/api.ts`

Run the backend locally (repo root):

```sh
docker compose up -d          # Postgres
cd backend && uv sync         # Intel Mac works after PR #7
uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload    # http://localhost:8000/docs
```

`frontend/.env.local`:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8000
NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL=ws://localhost:8000/ws
```

| Screen | Call | Request | Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 answer | `POST /responses` | **multipart form**: `participant_id`, `text?`, `audio?` (Blob), `neighborhood?`, `age?` (10–120). Send text or audio. | `202 {id, status: "pending"}`, `422` if both are empty, `413` if audio > 10 MB |
| 2 vote | `GET /statements?participant_id=…&limit=20` | — | `Statement[]`: approved statements, not yours, not yet voted |
| 2 vote | `POST /votes` | JSON `{participant_id, statement_id, value: "agree"\|"disagree"\|"pass"}` | `204`. Voting again overwrites. `404` for an unknown statement |
| 3 / board | `GET /clusters` | — | `ClusterResult` (same as `map_updated`) |
| board | `GET /bridges` | — | `Statement[]` |
| 3 "where you are" | (no endpoint) | find `points[].participant_id === getParticipantId()` in `/clusters` | |

```ts
// submitResponse
const form = new FormData();
form.append("participant_id", getParticipantId());
if (input.text) form.append("text", input.text);
if (input.audio) form.append("audio", input.audio, "answer.webm");
if (input.neighborhood) form.append("neighborhood", input.neighborhood);
if (input.age !== null) form.append("age", String(input.age));
const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/responses`, { method: "POST", body: form }); // no Content-Type header: the browser sets the boundary
if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`answer failed: ${res.status}`);
```

**WebSocket `/ws`:** sends `{type, data}` exactly like `ConsultationEvent`. On connect you immediately get `map_updated` and `bridges_updated` with the current state, then live updates after every answer or vote. Your `ws.ts` reconnect logic already fits.

**Timing:** an answer takes a few seconds to become statements (Gemini runs in the background). Don't wait on the POST; show "Mulțumim!" and move to screen 2. If `/statements` is empty, retry after ~3 s.
